mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT WEEK SHIFT_DATE,'PRE'||(RN-1)||'W' TYPE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT 'W'||SUBSTR(SHOP_WEEK,3,4) WEEK,SHIFT_DATE,SHOP_WEEK ,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY T.SHOP_WEEK DESC) RN FROM ODS.WP_CALENDAR T WHERE T.SHIFT_DATE<=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24,'YYYYMMDD') ) WHERE RN IN (2,3,4) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTR(SHIFT_DATE,5,4) SHIFT_DATE,'PRE' ||(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SHIFT_DATE DESC))||'D' TYPE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SHIFT_DATE FROM ODS.WP_CALENDAR T WHERE T.SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-7,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')) ) PIVOT ( MAX(SHIFT_DATE) FOR TYPE IN ( 'PRE1W' AS PRE1W, 'PRE2W' AS PRE2W, 'PRE3W' AS PRE3W, 'PRE1D' AS PRE1D, 'PRE2D' AS PRE2D, 'PRE3D' AS PRE3D, 'PRE4D' AS PRE4D, 'PRE5D' AS PRE5D, 'PRE6D' AS PRE6D, 'PRE7D' AS PRE7D ) )

SELECT '量测' TYPE,T.SHIFT_DATE,T.MOVE_RATIO_YD*100 MOVE_RATIO_YD,T.MOVE_RATIO_7D*100 MOVE_RATIO_7D,T.MOVE_RATIO_30D*100 MOVE_RATIO_30D ,T.SUFFER_CT_YD,T.SUFFER_CT_7D,T.SUFFER_CT_30D ,T.TTL_MOVE_YD,T.TTL_MOVE_7D,T.TTL_MOVE_30D,T.EQP_MOVE_YD,T.EQP_MOVE_7D,T.EQP_MOVE_30D,T.DYB_MOVE_YD,T.DYB_MOVE_7D ,T.DYB_MOVE_30D,T.QS_RATIO_YD*100 QS_RATIO_YD,T.QS_RATIO_7D*100 QS_RATIO_7D,T.QS_RATIO_30D*100 QS_RATIO_30D FROM A1MFG.MIT_SUFFER_SUMMARY T WHERE SHIFT_DATE= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND FAB=#{fab}

WITH calendar_data AS ( SELECT DISTINCT WEEK SHIFT_DATE,'PRE'||(RN-1)||'W' TYPE FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT 'W'||SUBSTR(SHOP_WEEK,3,4) WEEK,SHIFT_DATE,SHOP_WEEK ,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY T.SHOP_WEEK DESC) RN FROM ODS.WP_CALENDAR T WHERE T.SHIFT_DATE<=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24,'YYYYMMDD') ) WHERE RN IN (2,3,4) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT SHIFT_DATE,'PRE' ||(ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SHIFT_DATE DESC))||'D' TYPE FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SHIFT_DATE FROM ODS.WP_CALENDAR T WHERE T.SHIFT_DATE BETWEEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24-7,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-8/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')) ), product_status AS ( SELECT 'Pilot' PRODUCT_STATUS FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'M&R' PRODUCT_STATUS FROM DUAL ), base_data AS ( SELECT MODULE,EQP_G,SR FROM A1MFG.MIT_SUFFER_SR ) SELECT MODULE, EQP_G, PRODUCT_STATUS, METRIC_TYPE ITEM,
CASE WHEN PRE3W<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE3W END PRE3W ,CASE WHEN PRE2W<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE2W END PRE2W ,CASE WHEN PRE1W<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE1W END PRE1W ,CASE WHEN PRE1D<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE1D END PRE1D ,CASE WHEN PRE2D<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE2D END PRE2D ,CASE WHEN PRE3D<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE3D END PRE3D ,CASE WHEN PRE4D<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE4D END PRE4D ,CASE WHEN PRE5D<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE5D END PRE5D ,CASE WHEN PRE6D<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE6D END PRE6D ,CASE WHEN PRE7D<0 THEN NULL ELSE PRE7D END PRE7D
FROM (
SELECT T1.MODULE,T1.EQP_G,T1.PRODUCT_STATUS,T1.TYPE ,'S/R Tgt(OPD)' METRIC_TYPE,T1.SR VALUE FROM ( SELECT A1.*,A2.PRODUCT_STATUS,A3.SHIFT_DATE,A3.TYPE FROM base_data A1 ,product_status A2 ,calendar_data A3 WHERE 1=1 )T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM A1MFG.MIT_SUFFER_CT WHERE FAB=#{fab} ) T2 ON T1.EQP_G=T2.EQP_G AND T1.PRODUCT_STATUS=T2.PRODUCT_STATUS AND T1.SHIFT_DATE=T2.SHIFT_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.MODULE,T1.EQP_G,T1.PRODUCT_STATUS,T1.TYPE ,'S/R(基准情报)' METRIC_TYPE,T2.SR_PSR*100 VALUE FROM ( SELECT A1.*,A2.PRODUCT_STATUS,A3.SHIFT_DATE,A3.TYPE FROM base_data A1 ,product_status A2 ,calendar_data A3 WHERE 1=1 )T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM A1MFG.MIT_SUFFER_CT WHERE FAB=#{fab} ) T2 ON T1.EQP_G=T2.EQP_G AND T1.PRODUCT_STATUS=T2.PRODUCT_STATUS AND T1.SHIFT_DATE=T2.SHIFT_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.MODULE,T1.EQP_G,T1.PRODUCT_STATUS,T1.TYPE ,'S/R(ACT)' METRIC_TYPE,T2.SR_ACT*100 VALUE FROM ( SELECT A1.*,A2.PRODUCT_STATUS,A3.SHIFT_DATE,A3.TYPE FROM base_data A1 ,product_status A2 ,calendar_data A3 WHERE 1=1 )T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM A1MFG.MIT_SUFFER_CT WHERE FAB=#{fab} ) T2 ON T1.EQP_G=T2.EQP_G AND T1.PRODUCT_STATUS=T2.PRODUCT_STATUS AND T1.SHIFT_DATE=T2.SHIFT_DATE
UNION ALL
SELECT T1.MODULE,T1.EQP_G,T1.PRODUCT_STATUS,T1.TYPE ,'Suffer CT' METRIC_TYPE,T2.SUFFER_CT VALUE FROM ( SELECT A1.*,A2.PRODUCT_STATUS,A3.SHIFT_DATE,A3.TYPE FROM base_data A1 ,product_status A2 ,calendar_data A3 WHERE 1=1 )T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM A1MFG.MIT_SUFFER_CT WHERE FAB=#{fab} ) T2 ON T1.EQP_G=T2.EQP_G AND T1.PRODUCT_STATUS=T2.PRODUCT_STATUS AND T1.SHIFT_DATE=T2.SHIFT_DATE
) PIVOT ( MAX(VALUE) FOR TYPE IN ( 'PRE3W' AS PRE3W, 'PRE2W' AS PRE2W, 'PRE1W' AS PRE1W, 'PRE1D' AS PRE1D, 'PRE2D' AS PRE2D, 'PRE3D' AS PRE3D, 'PRE4D' AS PRE4D, 'PRE5D' AS PRE5D, 'PRE6D' AS PRE6D, 'PRE7D' AS PRE7D ) ) ORDER BY MODULE,EQP_G,PRODUCT_STATUS DESC, CASE METRIC_TYPE WHEN 'S/R Tgt(OPD)' THEN 1 WHEN 'S/R(基准情报)' THEN 2 WHEN 'S/R(ACT)' THEN 3 WHEN 'Suffer CT' THEN 4 END

UNION ALL
SELECT T1.MODULE,T1.EQP_G,T1.PRODUCT_STATUS,T1.TYPE ,'S/R(基准情报)' METRIC_TYPE,T2.SR_PSR*100 VALUE FROM ( SELECT A1.*,A2.PRODUCT_STATUS,A3.SHIFT_DATE,A3.TYPE FROM base_data A1 ,product_status A2 ,calendar_data A3 WHERE 1=1 )T1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM A1MFG.MIT_SUFFER_CT WHERE FAB=#{fab} ) T2 ON T1.EQP_G=T2.EQP_G AND T1.PRODUCT_STATUS=T2.PRODUCT_STATUS AND T1.SHIFT_DATE=T2.SHIFT_DATE

) PIVOT ( MAX(VALUE) FOR TYPE IN ( 'PRE3W' AS PRE3W, 'PRE2W' AS PRE2W, 'PRE1W' AS PRE1W, 'PRE1D' AS PRE1D, 'PRE2D' AS PRE2D, 'PRE3D' AS PRE3D, 'PRE4D' AS PRE4D, 'PRE5D' AS PRE5D, 'PRE6D' AS PRE6D, 'PRE7D' AS PRE7D ) ) ORDER BY MODULE,EQP_G,PRODUCT_STATUS DESC, CASE METRIC_TYPE WHEN 'S/R Tgt(OPD)' THEN 1 WHEN 'S/R(基准情报)' THEN 2 WHEN 'S/R(ACT)' THEN 3 WHEN 'Suffer CT' THEN 4 END
